class.name: OcgSelectmgrAndorfilter
class.brief_description: A framework to define an OR or AND selection filter. To use an AND selection filter call SetUseOrFilter with False parameter. By default the OR selection filter is used.
class.description: ! A framework to define an OR or AND selection filter. ! To use an AND selection filter call SetUseOrFilter with False parameter. ! By default the OR selection filter is used.

method.name: IsOk
method.description: Indicates that the selected Interactive Object passes the filter.

method.name: FilterType
method.description: Returns a selection filter type ( SelectMgr_FilterType).

method.name: SetFilterType
method.description: Sets a selection filter type. SelectMgr_FilterType_OR selection filter is used be default.
